findings: The canonical beta header is refreshed after navigation so resources and ownership stay current.
Each refresh still rewrote Gold, Harz and Dampf text even when unchanged and reapplied display:none!important to already-hidden historical header siblings.
changes: Header resource/version text is now written only when its visible value actually changed.
Historical header siblings receive display:none!important only when that style is not already present.
Navigation and header ownership checks still run on every existing buildHeader call.
Gold+, mail, friends, settings, Harz and Dampf button behavior is unchanged.
